integrity: The all-dimensional criterion is proved analytically from the exact two-by-two modal state matrix and Cayley--Hamilton. The embedded standard-library verifier only replays the displayed rational witness; finite experiments are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Positive diagonal Hessians in coordinates where the augmented penalty is scalar Euclidean; constant parameters with standard relaxation 0<alpha<=2. Noncommuting or singular Hessians, variable parameters, matrix penalties, and finite-precision robustness are not classified.
title: Finite-termination line geometry for scalar-penalty ADMM on diagonal quadratic consensus
